tasks.title: Validate Hosted Transactional Password-Reset Email Delivery (re-scoped, D-0064)
tasks.note: Re-scoped 2026-08-20 (D-0064): the original bundled requirement (exact dealership network, outbound reset-email connectivity, client isolation) is split. Task 1a (primary release gate) is ACCEPTED 2026-08-22: on public staging, a real password-reset request was delivered by the configured Resend transactional provider to a real inbox; the D-0048 identical-public-response guarantee held unchanged; the reset link used the public APP_BASE_URL; the link successfully changed the password and the new password logged in; the token was rejected as single-use on reuse; an unused token left roughly 18 minutes against the 15-minute lifetime was rejected as expired; 3-per-60-minute rate limiting behaved correctly and preserved the same generic response without sending another email; reviewed Render logs contained no RESEND_API_KEY, reset token, password, or complete reset URL. Task 1b (local fallback-network acceptance, NON-BLOCKING, NOT TESTED / NOT ACCEPTED): exact dealership Wi-Fi, client isolation, firewall restrictions, and local-mode recovery remain relevant only for local fallback mode (D-0002, retained by D-0061) and do not block v0.1.0. No Android or dealership-network compatibility is claimed. Acceptance used Resend's temporary testing sender configuration; final branded sender-domain configuration is future production/branding hardening, not an outstanding Task 1a release gate. See Decision Log D-0064 and the Sprint Master Checklist's Task 1 acceptance record for full detail.

tasks.title: Test Multiple Devices
tasks.note: Accepted 2026-08-20. PASS: Windows host, Microsoft Edge (host browser), Google Chrome (player browser), iPhone, and Safari — all verified against the public Render staging URL (Cloud Deployment Foundation Task 5's accepted retest plus a 2026-08-20 Edge/Chrome manual smoke test: Edge host login, Host Dashboard, game creation, and join URL display; Chrome player authentication, join, and answer submission; both browsers reaching final state with agreeing score/rank). NOT AVAILABLE / NOT TESTED: Android — no device is available to the project owner; the task's own 'where available' wording means this does not block acceptance, and Android remains a future compatibility check for whenever a device becomes available. Same-Wi-Fi local-network testing remains Task 1's fallback-validation scope, not this task's. See the Sprint Master Checklist's Task 2 device/browser acceptance for full evidence.

tasks.title: Implement Durable Cloud Persistence (deferred, D-0063)
tasks.note: Research recommended keeping SQLite and attaching a Render persistent disk for the current pilot stage (no PostgreSQL/Valkey/Redis/object storage yet). Task 6a (D-0062) designed that: a Starter plan plus a persistent disk (quizmaster-data) mounted at /opt/render/project/src/data covering ./data/ (database, avatar uploads, backups), DATABASE_PATH unchanged. The project owner has deferred implementing this (D-0063): render.yaml is back to plan: free with no disk block; no Starter-plan upgrade, disk creation, or recurring Render cost is authorized now. D-0062's design remains the preferred architecture for whenever paid persistence is activated. Task 6 remains open, not done, and not being actively implemented while this deferral stands; it will require a real Render restart-acceptance test after project-owner approval to resume (host authentication, an existing player account, imported questions, completed game history, an uploaded avatar, backup files, and the health check all surviving a deliberate restart).
